result.description:
Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.

We use data, augmented reality technology, machine learning, and robotics to re-engineer how sports are played. We use technology to change the game. With data and patented technology, we’ve made sports more accessible for beginners and aspiring professionals alike - whether you're here to play, complete, or improve.

We have a great pipeline of products and features we are working on over the next few years. There will be many aspects of the business to get involved in within our highly dynamic, passionate, and ever-growing team.

The BatFast team is looking for a multi-skilled candidate with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Services & Operations manager, who will help coordinate, develop and innovate the operational function within the business.

- Motivate the BatFast team members to share and fully implement new ideas

About Xtremepush

Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built-in CDP. It enables leading brands to leverage real-time data, AI and gamification to deliver highly personalised, lifecycle-specific customer journeys that drive conversions at scale. All with one unified solution.
Headquartered in Dublin, and with offices in London, New York, and São Paulo, the company helps operators all around the world understand their customers and improve player experiences world-wide.

Role Purpose 

The Sales and Marketing Manager (APAC) is responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating regional sales and marketing activities to drive revenue growth, customer retention, and brand expansion. The role combines strategic leadership with operational execution, overseeing account management functions, regional go-to-market strategies, and cross-functional collaboration to maximise organisational performance and market presence. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Sales & Marketing Strategy 
? Direct the development and execution of regional sales strategies, setting targets to maximise revenue, client growth, and customer loyalty. 
? Lead the creation and implementation of marketing and go-to-market strategies to promote the organisation’s products and services across APAC. 
? Drive initiatives to strengthen brand positioning, customer engagement, and long-term brand loyalty in the region. 
? Develop and implement strategies to enhance the organisation’s reputation with clients and stakeholders. 
2. Leadership & Team Management 
? Lead, manage, and grow a team of Account Managers across the APAC region. 
? Provide coaching, mentorship, and performance management to ensure high levels of engagement and productivity. 
? Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and development planning. 
? Lead recruitment and onboarding of new team members, including Account Managers and supporting roles. 
? Establish a high-performing regional team aligned with company values and objectives. 
3. Sales Pipeline & Revenue Management 
? Oversee and control the regional sales and account management pipeline to ensure alignment with revenue targets 
? Manage upsell, renewal, and retention strategies to achieve growth and minimise churn. 
? Analyse pipeline performance, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions. 
? Own forecasting accuracy and provide regular reporting and insights to senior leadership. 
4. Strategic Planning & Regional Expansion 
? Establish and lead the APAC regional function, defining how products and services are sold, managed, and scaled. 
? Contribute to pricing and packaging strategies tailored to regional market conditions. 
? Identify market trends, competitive insights, and customer feedback to inform strategic decisions. 
? Support expansion into new geographies across Asia and Oceania. 
5. Client Relationship & Account Oversight 
? Maintain senior-level relationships with key clients across the region. 
? Ensure high renewal rates, strong customer satisfaction, and delivery of value through account management practices. 
? Act as the primary escalation point for complex client issues across account management, onboarding, and support. 
? Attend strategic conferences and events within the region to promote the business and enforce strong client relations through face to face meetings 
? Oversee delivery quality and resource allocation for new and existing clients. 
6. Systems, Reporting & Process Optimisation 
? Direct the effective use of CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) to ensure accurate data management, reporting, and automation. 
? Implement best practices for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and customer engagement. 
? Collaborate with finance and operations to align sales forecasts with budgets and strategic plans. 
7. Cross-functional Collaboration 
? Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to ensure a unified customer approach. 
? Act as the regional liaison to ensure alignment of processes, communication, and execution. 
? Support new business initiatives, including RFP participation and market development activities. 
8. Operational & Support Oversight 
? Oversee service delivery standards, including SLAs, response times, and customer satisfaction metrics. 
? Support interim operational needs (e.g., customer support or onboarding) during regional scaling. 
? Ensure all business functions operate effectively within the APAC region. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Revenue & Growth 
? Achievement of upsell and revenue growth targets 
? High renewal rates and minimal customer churn 
Pipeline & Forecasting 
? Accuracy of sales forecasts 
? Maintenance of a healthy and progressing sales pipeline 
Customer Success 
? Strong client satisfaction and retention 
? Delivery of regular business reviews and strategic account engagement 
Team Performance 
? Development and retention of a high-performing team 
? Successful hiring and scaling of regional headcount 
Regional Leadership 
? Successful establishment and growth of APAC operations 
? Effective cross-functional alignment and operational delivery 

Skills & Experience 

? Minimum 3 years of relevant experience and Bachelor degrees in relevant field 
? Proven experience in sales and/or account management leadership roles 
? Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities in sales and marketing 
? Experience managing regional or international markets (APAC preferred) 
? Demonstrated ability to lead teams, drive performance, and scale operations 
? Strong analytical, forecasting, and CRM management skills 
? Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
